transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi there! Yes, I do have a few questions. First off, I'm wondering when I can start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Just avoid heavy or strenuous work for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, thank you for that information. I was also wondering when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide some more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, that's helpful to know. I'm also experiencing a lot of sensitivity to bright light. Is that normal after surgery?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Mild light sensitivity can be normal while the eye adjusts, and sunglasses outside can help. But if it is significant pain in bright light, or the eye is red and painful, that is not normal and may need checking. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the advice. I have one more question—should I still have some blurriness at this point in my recovery?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after surgery, and it should improve and settle down over time. If it is still blurry, or getting much worse, it may need checking. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's it for now. Thank you so much for answering all my questions!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thanks again for your help!

verdict.label: pass
